Tools For Company Research — APIbase.pro apibase@prod ~ /srv/apibase/company-research-intent APIbase.pro Pricing Catalog Connect Integrator Dashboard Contact Privacy Terms Moderation Frameworks Partners GitHub X Menu APIbase.pro Pricing Catalog Connect Integrator Dashboard Contact Privacy Terms Moderation Frameworks Partners GitHub X Tools for company research Official-registry company lookups across four jurisdictions, behind one endpoint — no per-registry signup. Live tools Tool Jurisdiction Price What it returns edgar.company_search United States (SEC EDGAR) $0.001 Search public companies by name, ticker, or keyword — company name, CIK number, form type, filing date edgar.company_facts United States (SEC EDGAR) $0.001 XBRL financials by CIK — revenue, net income, assets, liabilities, equity, EPS, last 5 reporting periods per metric edgar.filings United States (SEC EDGAR) $0.001 Recent filings by CIK — 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, proxy statements, with document URLs brreg.search Norway (Brønnøysundregistrene) $0.001 Search by company name, municipality, org form, or NACE code — org number, VAT status, employee count, address brasilapi.cnpj Brazil $0.002 Lookup by 14-digit CNPJ tax ID — name, address, CNAE codes, partners (QSA) abr.abn_lookup Australia $0.001 Resolve an Australian Business Number to full entity details All six are no-auth on the upstream side (public registries) — the live, always-current entries are at /api/v1/tools (filter with ?category=finance or ?category=business ) or via GET /api/v1/discover?intent=company+research . How to call it curl -X POST https://apibase.pro/api/v1/tools/edgar.company_search/call \ -H "Authorization: Bearer ak_live_..." \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{"params": {"query": "Tesla"}}' Not authenticated yet? /connect covers getting a key, or paying directly from a wallet with no key at all. What this covers today Four jurisdictions, not a global company database — a company outside the US, Norway, Brazil, or Australia isn't reachable through these specific tools yet. Each tool queries its own country's official registry directly; there is no cross-jurisdiction merge or entity-resolution step, so results are exactly what that one registry returns.
